d:
Cards on the table, and Kaur B is playing to win Presenting Seep Di Baazi, sung by Kaur B, with lyrics by Narinder Batth and music by Desi Crew.
Seep, the classic card game played at every Punjabi gathering, from village chaupals to late-night family sessions, sets the scene for this bold, playful track. Kaur B's powerful voice over Desi Crew's punchy beat makes it a full desi-swag anthem
Song Credits
Song - Seep Di Baazi
Artist - Kaur B
Lyrics - Narinder Batth
Music - Desi Crew
Label - Speed Record
